name: compot-writer
description: Create, revise, audit, and package numbered Chinese literature digests from academic PDFs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn academic PDFs into validated Chinese literature-digest packages.
interface.longDescription: Creates, revises, audits, and packages numbered Chinese 文献速递 with source-faithful writing, figures, Word formatting, companion files, and ZIP validation.
defaultPrompt: 根据我提供的学术论文 PDF，生成并验证一套编号文献速递 Word/ZIP。
审核现有文献速递的格式、命名和 ZIP 结构，并列出问题。
